Restated before interest: NVO paid 4,522mm DKK of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 0.54% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 29.59% to 29.04%. Restated at replacement capex: NVO spent 133,110mm DKK on plant over 2023 to 2025 against 19,625mm DKK of plant depreciation, 13.64% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge falls from 29.04% to 11.89%. Restated with selling costs: SG&A now carries NVO's filed selling or distribution costs, 20.81% of revenue this charge was absorbing, so it falls from 11.89% to nil. The filed lines alone now leave less than the cash the company made before interest and at replacement capex, and a charge below nil would credit the book with cash its own costs do not leave. Checked without one-off cash: deal payments are booked under investing, so free cash flow never carried them, and no settlement or transition tax is stated for the window, so the charge stands. Restated to the amortisation floor: the filed cost lines leave a 41.40% pre-tax margin where the cash over 2023 to 2025 supports 50.32%, so the charge rebuilds at -8.92%. It was held at nil, but NVO books 6,529mm DKK of non-cash amortisation of acquired intangibles inside its cost lines in FY2025 (0000353278-26-000012), 2.11% of revenue, so the charge stops at that floor: -2.11%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 NVO's cash flow statement shows receivables up 20,296mm DKK, inventories up 25,235mm DKK, payables up 15,158mm DKK, a working capital build of 30,373mm DKK, 3.65% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge was held at the amortisation floor, -2.11% where the filed figures rebuild it at -8.92%, and stays there.

column11: JUDGEMENT. No Phase 3 is registered. The two chronic heart failure Phase 2s complete 2027-05-16 (NCT06979375) and 2027-11-16 (NCT06979362), both on a biomarker primary endpoint, the change in miR-132 (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2), so an outcomes Phase 3 starts in 2028 at the earliest. Analogue: FINEARTS-HF (NCT04435626), the outcomes trial that gave Kerendia its heart failure label, started 2020-09-14 and reached primary completion 2024-05-15, and the label came on 2025-07-11 (NDA215341 supplement 9, book supplements table), so the first full year on sale, 2026, came six calendar years after the Phase 3 start. 2028 plus six is 2034
column12: Case for later: both Phase 2s measure a biomarker, so a study on a structural or clinical endpoint may come before a Phase 3, and HF-REVERT has already missed once (6-K 0001628280-25-038087). Novo gives no timing, so there is no case for earlier on file

column11: Both Phase 2s require LV hypertrophy on echocardiography (NCT06979362, NCT06979375: among the criteria, LV mass index above 115 g/m2 in men or 95 g/m2 in women on the linear formula), and the reduced ejection fraction trial also admits LV dilatation. LV hypertrophy on exactly that threshold was present in 52% of the TOPCAT echocardiographic study (456 of the 875 of its 935 heart failure patients with a measurable LV mass index), 43% concentric and 9% eccentric, read by a core laboratory, 52% of them enrolled in the US (Shah AM et al., Circ Heart Fail 2014;7(1):104-115, doi:10.1161/CIRCHEARTFAILURE.113.000887, PMID 24249049, PMC4467731). Applied to the whole pool, both ejection fraction halves: for the reduced half it is a floor, because LV mass index runs higher in reduced than in preserved ejection fraction (118 against 98 g/m2 among 831 consecutive heart failure outpatients, ESC Heart Fail 2021, doi:10.1002/ehf2.13366, PMID 34085774, PMC8318400) and that trial also admits dilatation without hypertrophy. 0.52 x 7.4mm = about 3.85mm
column12: Case for lower: PARAGON-HF's echocardiographic study, on the same core laboratory and formula, found LV hypertrophy in 21% of 1,097 patients with preserved ejection fraction (Shah AM et al., J Am Coll Cardiol 2019;74(23):2858-2873, doi:10.1016/j.jacc.2019.09.063, PMID 31806129, PMC13537700); the same paper puts it at 42% to 75% in community cohorts and about 60% in hospital registries, which brackets 52%. Not applied, for want of a label that would carry them: NYHA class II to III with weekly diuretics (87% and 88% of the reduced and preserved outpatients above), NT-proBNP of 300 pg/mL or more, and the exclusions of eGFR below 30 and, in the preserved trial, implanted devices. Case for higher: the preserved trial also accepts a septal thickness of 1.1 cm in women or 1.2 cm in men, a looser test than LV mass
